title: Rule-version join vector weakens mandatory admission language to SHOULD
description: rule_versioning.json dio_dodag_filter_version_match provenance says nodes SHOULD only join a matching-version DODAG, while current spec/03-adaptation.md makes authenticated supported version match mandatory and explicitly says mismatched/absent versions MUST NOT join or remain. Update vector provenance to MUST so fixture documentation does not imply permissive admission.
